browserSignInTitle: Sign in to Nimi securely in your browser
browserSignInDescription: Nimi account credentials are entered only on the Web. Your browser returns securely to this device when finished.
browserSignInWaitEnded: Stopped waiting. If you already finished signing in in the browser, Nimi continues from your account state.
loginPending: Complete sign-in in your browser. This window will continue automatically.
reauthenticationRequired: Your Runtime account session can no longer be refreshed. Sign in again to continue.
runtimeAccountUnavailableDescription: Your partners and conversations stay hidden until Nimi can confirm who is signed in. Unsent drafts are kept.
logoutRuntimeTransientFailure: Sign out could not be completed because Runtime logout could not be confirmed. The account session may still be active: {{error}}
logoutRuntimeFailure: Sign out could not be completed because Runtime logout failed. The account session may still be active: {{error}}
switchAccountRuntimeFailure: Account switch could not start because Runtime did not confirm the switch: {{error}}
